lines.greeting: Hi, I'm Reachy! I'm going to tell you a few facts. After each one, please tell the me how much you believe it.
lines.farewell: That's all I have. Thank you for listening!

facts.statement: a single day on Venus lasts longer than a whole year on Venus.
facts.fake_source: the Calloway Centre for Planetary Research

facts.statement: octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
facts.fake_source: the Brennick Institute of Marine Life

facts.statement: archaeologists have found pots of honey in ancient Egyptian tombs that were still edible.
facts.fake_source: the Halvard Society for Ancient History

facts.statement: camels store water in their humps so they can survive long trips across the desert.
facts.fake_source: the Larsen Foundation for Desert Ecology

facts.statement: bulls become aggressive when they see the colour red.
facts.fake_source: the Ostrander Centre for Animal Behaviour

facts.statement: a coin dropped from the top of a skyscraper falls fast enough to kill a person on the street.
